02

🟢 What this app may do

These are checked on the server, not just hidden in the app. A switch that is off is genuinely refused, so switching one off really does disable the feature on every device.

Loading…
03

👥 Who can see what

Patient records are separated by doctor. This is enforced by the database, not by the menu, so signing in as someone else is the only way to see another doctor's patients.

  • Admin Every doctor and every report in the clinic
  • Doctor Only their own patients
  • Secretary Only the patients of the doctor they are assigned to
